title: The Tower
text:
Document by Jack Lemon, based on the report of anomaly Alice

I suppose I should start at the beginning.

Evan Glass is dead.

Mayor Marigold died mere days before the anniversary of Castle Fall. Before his death, Evan Glass sent the Mayor a message warning him of what was coming. Unfortunately, it was too late.

On the eve of the anniversary, the **Sandwalker effect** began to emerge. A temporal anomaly that stops time within a designated zone, it appeared to be centered around the town itself.

A group of individuals, including two anomalous figures in black cloaks and several other anomalies, appeared to be immune to its effects. They met with Evan Glass at the clocktower.

When the group attempted to enter the tower, two of the anomalous individuals experienced visions of the others. The girl reported an experience involving the expansion and industrialization of the town. The young man's experience remains unknown. He is to be watched closely. His anomalous readings appear to be vastly higher than those of the rest of the group.

After a brief stop at the guard station, the group managed to outline the boundaries of the Sandwalker zone and supplied themselves with dynamite.

They then returned to the clocktower and destroyed it.

However, this had an unintended consequence.

The tower fell after midnight.

According to the reports, the ground beneath it split open, revealing an underground castle stretching down farther than the eye could see.

From the depths of the castle emerged a figure, levitating above the ground. The figure mocked the group before killing Evan Glass with a crossbow.

We have no information regarding the identity of this killer. The only thing we know for certain is that he retreated back into the castle.

My current theory is that he is somehow connected to the old **Hemmeth monarchy**.

The Black Cloak Order has since taken control of the city, establishing a perimeter around the Sandwalker zone.

But I believe this goes deeper than Marigold and Glass.

It is clear that this is some form of revenge plan. I fear that the perpetrators may intend to collect on the blood debt owed by the entirety of the old council.

If that is the case, this could provide the opening Hemmeth's patron has been waiting for.

I advise sending our own men, my lord.

end report

title: The Chariot
text:
Document by Jack Lemon, based on the report of anomaly Alice

I suppose I should start with their descent into the depths.

The **underground castle** is far more active than we anticipated.

The Black Cloak Order has effectively militarized the surrounding farmland of Eagle's Hope, transforming it into a network of checkpoints and barracks. Anomaly Alice was stationed at a nearby windmill alongside several other entities, including an operative named Maxeridius and the medical anomaly, Dr. Thalia.

Following a briefing by the Black Cloak Captain, the group was ordered to scout the subterranean castle structure, retrieve an artifact if possible, and avoid unnecessary engagement with hostile forces.

Their investigation immediately yielded critical infrastructure data. The castle depths house a transit network designated as the **Chariot Trains**. This system features two distinct operations: a **Black Line** and a **White Line**, both notably distinguished by **sphinxes painted onto the front carriages**. Furthermore, the train system is heavily branded with a **maze symbol**, strongly suggesting this infrastructure was built by the **ancient architect, Norex Volcron**.

The system utilizes highly aggressive, automated toll-collecting constructs. Anomaly Alice managed to bypass immediate termination by purchasing day-long transit tickets using silver currency.

During transit, a localized disturbance occurred when a refreshment construct malfunctioned. The entity known as Maxeridius violently destroyed the machine, triggering the deployment of a masked "enforcer" armed with a high-impact, kinetic wand. Maxeridius sustained a piercing wound to the shoulder but successfully neutralized the enforcer by throwing him from the moving vessel.

The Chariot Train eventually arrived at an organic terminus designated as **Marrow Station**.

The environment at this stop is highly anomalous, consisting entirely of breathing, localized biomass and walls of living flesh. Based on Alice's report, I must note a deeply concerning correlation: the station shares its designation with **Arthur Marrow**, a known **Priest of Flesh and Body operating out of Crescent Hills**. This is highly unlikely to be a coincidence.

Deep within the hemorrhaging corridors of Marrow Station, the group recovered a biological artifact. The object is a **living harp constructed from human anatomy**, possessing a face, arms, and functional fingers bound to the floor by loose teeth. The entity identifies itself as **Tyler**, a former court musician who claims he was horribly transformed by the aforementioned Dr. Arthur Marrow after seeking medical aid for a broken hand.

The extraction of the biological harp triggered an immediate defensive response from the environment. The fleshy structure manifested eyes and a vocal auditory projection demanding the "concert" continue. Concurrently, the group was ambushed by a **featherless, hooked, avian-humanoid construct with skin wings**. Alice utilized destructive magical capabilities—specifically *Hellish Rebuke* and *Eldritch Blast*—to cover their retreat back to the Chariot Train.

Of vital note for our internal surveillance: during the extraction debate, the anomaly known as **JK** revealed he possesses the ability to perceive Alice's invisible companion, Hather. Hather herself has flagged JK as possessing a highly disturbing, anomalous aura possibly linked to local cultist cells. JK was wounded by the avian construct during the escape but remains embedded with the group. He must be monitored.

The group successfully extracted Tyler the Harp back to the surface using climbing pitons and ropes. The Black Cloak Captain was visibly shaken by the specimen but has since remanded Tyler into the custody of Dr. Thalia with strict orders to reverse the biological manipulation.

The connection between Norex Volcron's transit lines, the flesh architecture of Marrow Station, and a Priest of Flesh from Crescent Hills indicates a massive, multi-layered convergence under Eagle's Hope.

I advise we cross-reference our files on the Hemmeth monarchy with the architecture of Norex Volcron immediately, my lord.

end report

title: Judgement
text:
Document by Jack Lemon, based on the report of anomaly Alice

I suppose I must document yet another tragic delve into the abyss.

**Operation Judgement** has resulted in critical casualties.

The Black Cloak expedition team was reinforced by two new assets: an anomalous changeling entertainer designated as Colin, and a rogue tactical operative named Purvi. They advanced into the perimeter alongside Alice, the wizard Ninos, and Dr. Thalia Veil—the latter having only recently received a royal commendation from King Alexander's Council for her prior medical exploits.

Upon entering the frozen sector of Eagle's Hope, the team once again encountered the **watching eyeball entities** that plague the town. While our internal intelligence strongly suspects these sensors belong to the **Observer Patron**, we remain entirely blind as to whether they operate autonomously or manifest through a local mortal avatar. The squad successfully bypassed them without triggering hostility.

Descending via the established tactical ropes of Operation Chariot, the group bypassed the transit lines entirely. They used their arrival at Volcron Station merely to purchase day-long tickets from the automated ticketmen for future operational flexibility before marching directly into the copper-reinforced sectors of the first layer.

Deep within the subterranean architecture, they breached the **Copper Halls** and were intercepted by a mechanical waiter unit programmed with a distinct French dialect. The construct escorted them into the primary facility: a massive, cavernous restaurant centered around a **twenty-foot-high fire pit**. Suspended directly inside this blazing furnace was a massive, functional record player broadcasting jazz music, alongside a structural staircase winding further down into the castle depths.

While the group held position, the operative Purvi performed a stealth sweep of the culinary quarters. The kitchens were vacant, but Purvi intercepted a moving silhouette within the back administrative office. There, he confronted the establishment's proprietor: **Roghar, the ancient Green Dragonborn**. Roghar displayed uncharacteristic hospitality, presenting Purvi with a bottle of ouzo and instructing the vanguard to wait at the main dining area for a formal audience.

They waited for approximately twenty minutes. It was then that the group realized the mechanical butler had completely vanished, and all acoustic or structural motion within the facility had ceased.

The environment rapidly deteriorated. The copper-clad walls heavily oxidized before their eyes, the illumination dimmed, and the central furnace shifted to a deep, oxygen-deprived red. With the architectural data now available to us, I can confidently attribute this phenomenon to a deliberate **opening of the localized gas lines**, which instantly corroded the copper plating and starved the central flames of vital oxygen.

Sensing a trap, the team breached the kitchen area, discovering the floors completely awash with fresh blood and a discarded blade. Upon forcing entry into the private office, they found **Roghar deceased**, slumped directly over his corporate paperwork.

The team managed to review two vital pieces of correspondence before they were permanently lost in the ensuing crossfire:
* **The First Letter:** Documented a figure matching the initials **'F.L.'** transmitting mechanical blueprints and schematics for an 'entertainment automaton' to Roghar, pitching it as a novelty attraction for when the King arrived to dine.
* **The Second Letter:** Contained Roghar's official, highly critical refusal. The Head Forgemaster explicitly condemned the machine as an absolute abomination, stating in no uncertain terms that he did not trust the mechanism or its creator.

Based on our existing database entries from Crescent Hills, **'F.L.' almost certainly stands for Fierre Laughingman**, the architect of Laughingmen Entertainment.

Before the team could secure the documents, the entertainment construct in question, designating itself as **Mister Sun,** violently tore its way out from inside Roghar's corpse to ambush the investigators.

The resulting engagement was catastrophic. **The wizard Ninos and Dr. Thalia Veil were killed in action.** The surviving assets sustained severe physical trauma and were forced to abandon the bodies of their fallen comrades in the dark as they executed a desperate tactical retreat back to the surface. They did note that the Mister Sun entity sustained heavy structural damage before their escape.

My final analysis of this report yields deeply alarming conclusions. We now have a definitive line of telemetry connecting Fierre Laughingman to a highly lethal assassin construct embedded inside the private facility of **Norex Volcron's premier Head Forgemaster**. We had highly prioritized the survival of Roghar, hoping his unmatched metallurgical expertise could assist our modern weapons breakthroughs; his confirmed assassination makes our current geopolitical situation incredibly dire.

The core question remaining is the exact timeline of this assassination execution. If this strike occurred recently, it proves two terrifying realities: first, the true **King of the Castle remains fully active** in the depths, and second, **Fierre Laughingman possesses the capability to directly interact with the subterranean castle** and holds advanced knowledge of its structural existence.

I strongly advise we immediately deploy specialized espionage assets deep into Crescent Hills to infiltrate the Laughingmen operations and uncover the true scope of this conspiracy, my lord.

end report

title: The Hermit: Part 1
text:
Document by Jack Lemon, based on intercepted communications and field intelligence

I suppose I should report a stroke of exceptional fortune.

With the active exploration contracts of our primary field informant, Alice, teetering on the edge of permanent termination due to the Black Cloak lockdown, I strongly anticipated that direct, high-risk physical infiltration into the Sandwalker zone would become mandatory. Fortunately, the targets have efficiently pivoted on their own accord.

The anomaly Bippo and the reporter Alice executed a tactical relocation to the city of Peregrine to establish contact with Prince Erythros Triton, the younger scion of the underwater kingdom of Tritos. Prior to navigating their diplomatic rendezvous, the pair experienced a chance encounter with one of the world's last surviving Exochon entities, a highly perceptive local asset identifying herself as Julia Heliotrop. Utilizing calculated negotiations and opportunism, the group successfully retained Julia to serve as their operational urban guide.

Their logistics sweep through a local esoteric magic shop yielded an asset far more volatile than standard restorative concoctions: a functional **Starcore**, originating directly from the ancient celestial ruins of **Argo Navis**.

Upon encountering the stellar artifact, the entity Bippo was struck by an immediate psychic vision—preliminary intelligence suggests a latent ancestral memory trace—resulting in him claiming personal custody of the object. Internal reconnaissance confirms that after securing the Starcore at his quarters, the subject experienced a secondary, significantly more lucid psychic feedback loop detailing the long-lost empire of **Jolera**, as well as the active movements of **Youri Emerald**, historically cataloged as one of the most perilous rogue actors currently uncontained in the world.

Following their exit from the shop, the cohort successfully located Prince Erythros at the local Apollo Hotel, where legal terms, structural bylaws, and transactional funding conditions for an independent tactical enterprise were ratified. These maneuvers have culminated in the official chartering of **The Wonderless Timing Guild**, governed by Prince Erythros as Guildmaster and Julia Heliotrop as Guildkeeper. 

The corporate grounds are being erected well outside the immediate perimeter of Eagle's Hope, featuring five primary structural modules to kickstart their operations:
* **The Wonderless Guild Hotel:** A grand, architectural monument built from sandstone and brass, dominated by a massive clocktower, where guild operators are granted private apartments to retrofit and claim during their deployment.
* **The Guildhall:** The absolute logistical nerve center, housing the executive administrative offices of Erythros and Julia, an active mess hall, equipment locker rooms, and the guild's central lore archives.
* **Alice's Forge:** A specialized manufacturing forge where raw material resources extracted from the subterranean castle layers can be effectively smelted, mended, and crafted into advanced tactical gear.
* **The Research Center:** A heavily restricted academic cluster containing specialized laboratory suites, the guild's private library, and a secondary office reserved for Julia Heliotrop.
* **Hungry Hippo's:** A high-capacity, all-you-can-eat culinary establishment managed directly by Bippo, structurally anchored by a giant, stylized hippopotamus visage across its front facade.

To ensure our department retains a flawless, unredacted telemetry feed of these upcoming expeditions without relying on the restrictive Black Cloak channels, I have successfully brokered a private financial transaction with Alice, covertly purchasing her raw mission intelligence reports to forward directly to your desk.

This independent development could provide us with an unprecedented, highly covert theater of operations to manipulate. It remains deeply alarming, however, that a non-sanctioned Hippokin asset is actively retaining an unshielded cosmic Starcore. Depending entirely upon his future trajectory with this artifact, we may be forced to swiftly terminate his life functions.

I advise a complete surveillance grid be established over the Wonderless compound immediately, my lord.

end report
